episodes.title: Bigg Boss Season 20 Episode 67
episodes.description: Catch all the uncut drama, nominations, and weekend action of Bigg Boss Season 20 Episode 67.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 65: Nominations Bring Unexpected Twists
episodes.description: Arishfa and Lovepreet's clash escalates as Scout questions Yung's silence. Will Qazi's prank and heated nomination arguments deepen the rifts in the house?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 64: Make Noise for Jasmine Sandlas!
episodes.description: Qazi gets a makeover, but his prank turns ugly as he clashes with Manish! Wrapping the Diwali week with a bang, Jasmine Sandlas takes the stage with her powerhouse performance.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 63: Diwali Mehfil Ft. Mohit Chauhan
episodes.description: Qazi is back in his rockstar mood, kickstarting the Diwali party. The Mehfil begins as Mohit Chauhan and Harrdy Sandhu join in, but post-celebrations, the time for eviction nears!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 62: It’s a Star-studded Party
episodes.description: The festive mood elevates as Salman kicks off the celebrations for Bigg Boss’ new milestone. From Karan Johar to Shanaya Kapoor, beloved stars join in for a ‘Dhamakedar’ evening!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 61: The Diwali Bash Begins!
episodes.description: Arishfa lands a special offer in the 2X room, but she must get the Gharwaales’ support. Amid serious clashes, the ‘Mahaul’ turns cosy as Diwali celebrations begin in full-swing!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 60: Milega Pyaar Ya Vaar?
episodes.description: Another emotional moment follows as Arishfa must choose between gaining a life or claiming Amrapali’s message. Further, Scout seeks clarity on the message sent by his family.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 59: Bada Expose, Bade Sacrifice!
episodes.description: The message sent by Lovepreet’s mother exposes Mahhi’s remarks while making Amrapali reconsider her friendship. To claim Yung’s family message, a housemate must make a sacrifice!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 58: Ghar Se Aaya Pyaar-Samachar!
episodes.description: The post-nomination bitterness comes out in the form of heated clashes. But emotions take over as Gharwaales get a chance to receive messages from home, albeit with a catch!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 57: Nominations Ka Khatra
episodes.description: Post Weekend Ka Vaar, Mahhi’s remarks trigger Kanika again, while group equations shift. Nominations bring a twist, and Arishfa and Scout clash once more.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 56: Who Has the Real Rizz?
episodes.description: Salman challenges Scout to step up as hidden opinions and fake bonds are exposed. Elvish brings a fun Rizz Master test before a shocking eviction.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 55: Salman Exposes the Housemates
episodes.description: Salman questions Scout’s loyalty and calls out Amrapali, Gullu and Mahhi for their gameplay. Will the housemates own up to their actions and face the truth?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 54: Ask Salman Anything!
episodes.description: Mahhi comforts a disheartened Yung as he feels sidelined by his friends. Excitement flares as Gharwaales get a chance to ask Salman anonymous questions, to be addressed during WKV!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 53: Captaincy Race - Andar Ya Bahar?
episodes.description: With all eyes on the captain’s throne, the Gharwaales put it all on the line to stay alive in the race! Yung feels betrayed by his friends, triggering a confrontation with Scout.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 52: The Decider 2X Room
episodes.description: Amid the nomination task, Lovepreet breaks down over her ongoing fiasco with Scout! The doors to 2X room open, where Mahhi gets another shot at captaincy, but there’s a catch.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 51: Absolute Chaos
episodes.description: Arishfa calls out the Gharwaales for breaking a rule, and more fights continue to run in a loop! Gullu and Kanika devise a plot, while the nomination game begins in full swing.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 50: Ek Bawaal, Many Sawaal!
episodes.description: The aftereffects of Kaashvi’s confrontation take over, with Lovepreet suffering a big breakdown! While she raises questions at Scout, a new clash stirs between Kanika and Uditi.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 49: Surprise Guests and Reality Checks
episodes.description: Sonakshi Sinha and Zaheer Iqbal play a fun quiz while Farrhana Bhatt motivates the Gharwaales. Kaashvi Hiranandani’s surprise entry turns up the heat for Love and Scout.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 48: Rohit Shetty Drops Truth Bombs
episodes.description: Rohit Shetty is here with a reality check for the Gharwaales, from Yung and Aasif to Love and Scout. Eviction brings a major twist with two lifelines at stake. Who survives?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 47: Ek Vishesh Adhikaar, Kai Dawedaar
episodes.description: A surprise Vishesh Adhikaar win shakes things up in the Captaincy task. Yung opens up about his past, and Love and Amrapali clash over cooking duties! Who becomes the new captain?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 46: Dosti Mein Daraar?
episodes.description: While captaincy Daawedaars are named, friendships show cracks. Tensions rise between Qazi and Scout, and Arishfa and Love. Scout and Kanika wonder who is really close to whom.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 45: Broke a Rule? Get Burnt by BB
episodes.description: Captain Scout gets a special power that’ll hold crucial for the new captaincy contendership! Further, a rule break brings serious repercussions for the entire house.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 44: Nominations - Kitne Doshi?
episodes.description: It’s nomination time, and a war of words ensues as the Gharwaales must nominate based on the 'Dosh'! While captain Scout gets a special power, Aasif and Qazi lock horns mid-task.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 43: A Bitter Revenge!
episodes.description: The post-WKV vibe is all about clashes, as rifts continue among Scout, Yung, and Qazi. But Arishfa unleashes the big storm as she goes on a vengeance mode against the Gharwaales.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 42: Knock, Knock? It’s Time to Exit
episodes.description: Salman brings a series of confrontation tasks that let Gharwaales speak up against each other! While this unfurls bitter clashes, tension peaks as the exit door is about to open.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 41: Pehle Expose, Phir Explode
episodes.description: Salman holds nothing back, calling out some Gharwaales’ inaction and vile tactics! While the reality check is served, Kanika and Yung get praised for standing by the right.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 40: BB Says, Take a Life!
episodes.description: A rebellion brews in the house as Arishfa feels targeted. BB adds a new twist—with time and ration running out, the housemates must decide whose life to sacrifice.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 39: Select. Eliminate. Elect!
episodes.description: The captaincy race gets intense as the ultimate power lies in the hands of ex-captains, who’ll elect the next house captain! Emotions run high as Arishfa shares a moment with Qazi.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 38: Action Ka Reaction, BB-style!
episodes.description: After the explosive clash, Gharwaales question Nakul’s actions. While BB delivers a strong judgement, Lovepreet's unexpected move triggers the housemates.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 37: Gazab Mudde, Gazab Bezzati
episodes.description: Nominations Ki Baithak in BB Gazab Bezzati Zone turns heated as Mary, Uditi and Arishfa clash. A minor spat between Nakul and Gullu explodes, sending the Gharwaales into chaos.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 36: Kalesh Trending Hai!
episodes.description: The new wildcards become the buzz of the house as the Gharwaales decode their personalities. Qazi and Gullu plot a prank, while Arishfa and Kanika go berserk in a heated face-off!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 35: Salman Turns Up the Heat
episodes.description: Salman confronts Scout, Yung and Aman over their actions and calls out the Gharwalas for lacking empathy towards Qazi. With eviction looming, a surprise entry awaits.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 34: Whose Game Needs a Rebirth?
episodes.description: Salman puts the Gharwalas in the spotlight as Gullu names three who are yet to reveal themselves. With Roadies Rebirth fun and a wildcard twist, who will shake up the game?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 33: Love Says, Checkmate!
episodes.description: New clashes continue to upend the house! But the real politics unfold when Love leverages her ‘Vishesh Adhikaar’, which becomes the deciding factor in the captaincy battle.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 32: The Ration Heist!
episodes.description: Scout’s comment on Love and Yung’s equation doesn’t sit well, and a clash ensues! The real drama unfolds in BB’s ration godown as Love’s unexpected move triggers everyone.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 31: It’s Debate Time
episodes.description: Aasif steps into the shoes of a news anchor, bringing the latest scoop of the house! Eyeing captaincy contendership, the Gharwaales aim to win the debate. Who’ll make a mark?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 30: No More Pyaar, Only Takraar!
episodes.description: The nomination ring comes to a close, but captain Uditi’s ‘Vishesh Adhikaar’ adds a new twist. Further, the aftereffects of nominations kick in, where old bonds begin to crack!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 29: Pack a Nomination Punch!
episodes.description: The kitchen clash is on, where Mahhi and Uditi find themselves at loggerheads. Post WKV, the house dynamics change once again, and it all unravels in the nomination-special ring!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 28: Surprise Ya Shock?
episodes.description: Ayushmann Khurrana, Sara Ali Khan, Mika Singh and more special guests join Salman on stage. Fun and games take over, but the danger of eviction looms large over the Gharwaales.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 27: Salman Demands Honest Answers
episodes.description: Salman asks the Gharwalas to name those they admire and those they see flaws in. Qazi faces scrutiny over Kanika, while Aasif gets praised for stepping up.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 26: Mid-week Eviction!
episodes.description: Tension heightens in the house with an unexpected eviction! With new twists in the game every day, the captaincy race gets grittier. Who’ll emerge as the new leader?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 25: Darr Ka Mahaul Ft. Dolly
episodes.description: A new debate stirs over the kitchen clash between Mahhi and Mary! The house turns jolly as BB introduces Dolly, and the boys must follow her orders to bag captaincy contendership!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 24: Rate the Captain! Yea or Nay?
episodes.description: It’s a ‘1 v all’ situation for Qazi as his comment sets Kanika off and turns the Gharwaales against him! Gullu gets another shot at captaincy contendership, but there’s a catch.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 23: Mission Ration, Phir Captain?
episodes.description: As old bonds take a hit, the house dynamics begin to change! Fierce face-offs follow in the captaincy contendership task, where captaincy and ration are up for grabs.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 22: Room 2X - Double the Twists!
episodes.description: The doors to Room 2X open, granting captain Gullu the power of ‘Jeevandan’. While he leverages this game-changing power, BB drops another bomb with the new nomination twist!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 21: Salman’s Star-Studded Evening
episodes.description: Ajay Devgn and Jaideep Ahlawat join Salman as the Gharwaalas face a courtroom twist. Amid the fun and masti, one Gharwaala’s journey comes to an end.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 20: Salman Ka Reality Check!
episodes.description: Salman grills the Gharwalas over the diss battle as Rhiti faces his ire for crossing the line. Jealousy sparks revelations, while Yung ranks his group members.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 19: And the New Captain Is…
episodes.description: The Gharwaales rally behind their favourite Daavedaar in the final captaincy match, where Yung and Qazi lock horns! But the big question—who’ll bag the coveted captainship?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 18: Ulta Prachar, Race Se Bahar!
episodes.description: The diss battle nears a banger climax, and the house gets its captaincy contenders! But the Gharwaales will take the final call. Who’ll face rejection, and who’ll ace this race?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 17: Diss Battle - Pyaar Se Vaar!
episodes.description: The race for captaincy contendership is on, with the house turning into a diss battleground. As team Qazi and team Yung go head to head, fiery clashes ensue.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 16: Kaun Top, Kaun Flop?
episodes.description: The rift between the groups deepens as Yung and Aman’s clash takes an ugly turn. But the chaos is just getting started as the Gharwaales must rank each other in the ration task!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 15: Nominations with a Twist!
episodes.description: Equations between the Gharwaales are put to the test as the Nominations begin. With rations dwindling, Bigg Boss offers a luxury basket, but it comes at a very high cost.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 14: Entertainment, Elimination, Exposé
episodes.description: Salman gives Qazi a unique reality check. Munawar and Sonali roast the Gharwaales, while Sidharth and Tamannaah bring fun games. Who will bid farewell to the house tonight?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 13: Salman Laye Hain 'Sach Ki Topi'
episodes.description: Salman settles the clashes in the house with Sach Ki Topi. Scout gets schooled and Aasif's aggression is called out. A shocking move awaits the Gharwaales!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 12: A Risky Ration Quiz
episodes.description: Lovepreet's remark upsets Amrapali, while Mahi and Uditi question Mary's contribution. During the Ration Quiz, can the Gharwaales match Gullu's answers?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 11: Captaincy Chaos Erupts
episodes.description: A shocking elimination from the captaincy task leads to betrayals, heated fights, and provocative remarks between the Gharwaales. Eventually, the house crowns its new Captain!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 10: Loyalties Put to the Test
episodes.description: Mahi's support for a rival strains her bond with Yung while Amrapali calls out Lovepreet's loyalty. Boys get their final captaincy pick. How will the girls decide theirs?

episodes.title: BBHin Day 09: Rang Mein Bhang, Ghar Mein Jung
episodes.description: Amrapali and Mahi's food fight sparks a house-wide clash! Captaincy ki daawedari shuru as Gharwaales pick sides. Post the task, Arishfa and Scout's argument becomes chaotic.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 08: Secrets Out! Sparks Fly
episodes.description: Uditi and Aasif clash while nomination drama engulfs the Gharwaales. Bigg Boss exposes hidden strategies plotted by a few housemates, leading to a fiery post-nomination fight.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 07: Gajab Beizzati, Peak Masti
episodes.description: It’s time for ‘Gajab Beizzati’ as Aasif takes on a roasting challenge. The fun continues with Yung and Mahi playing matchmakers, while Salman readies to announce Janta’s faisla!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 06: Pehla Vaar! Ft. OG Rockstar
episodes.description: Pehla, pehla ‘Vaar’ hain! Salman Khan brings his ‘rockstar’ energy to the stage as he praises Qazi’s performance. Alongside a few reality checks, follow a series of fun tasks.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 05: Rule Break? Discipline Check!
episodes.description: Captain Yung tries to keep Kanika in check over house rules, but their verbal spat drags the entire house. Further, a rule break by the boys triggers serious repercussions!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 04: Rewind! 20 Years of Bigg Boss
episodes.description: The captaincy task reaches its deciding stage, while new alliances hint at brewing politics. Further, the ‘Mahaul’ gets emotional as Bigg Boss’ 20-year legacy comes alive!

episodes.title: BBHin Day 03: All Eyes on 'Pehla Kaptaan'
episodes.description: Gossip intensifies with ‘rockstar’ Qazi becoming the talk of the house! As the BB movie premiere begins, Gharwaales rally behind their favourite for the coveted first captaincy.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 02: Sanchalan Gone Wrong?
episodes.description: BB’s birthday party heats up as ‘Sanchalak’ Qazi faces the Gharwaales’ wrath. Doors to the '2X Room' open, bringing a special power for the captaincy contenders.

episodes.title: BBHin Day 01: Kanika's Boon, Housemates' Bane!
episodes.description: The Gharwaales begin to settle in, but with growing connections, new conflicts follow! Kanika uses her special 'Vardaan', while BB's 20th birthday bash begins with a twist.

episodes.title: BBHin Grand Premiere: Vardaan ya Toofan?
episodes.description: Get ready for 'Two-much' fun as your beloved Host-Dost, Salman Khan, unveils the grand Season 20 in style! All eyes are on the 'Vardaan', which will power this epic game.
